proof_scope: retained guard that needs_human status reports are routed through ops-discord and fail closed when delivery proof is absent

claims.proves: The Shame extension contains the needs_human -> ops-discord delivery hook, rejects absent delivery proof, documents the no-exceptions policy, and the configured Discord bot transport resolves in dry-run.
claims.does_not_prove: A live post was sent during this eval or that Discord will be reachable in every future session.

cases.name: needs-human-discord-hook-present
command:
cd ../../.. && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
idx=Path('extensions/pi/lazy-report-shame-shame-shame/index.ts').read_text()
skill=Path('skills/shame/SKILL.md').read_text()
required=['notifyNeedsHumanViaDiscord(status)','statusState === "needs_human"','needs_human_discord_delivery_failed','ops_discord.notification_receipt.v1','receipt?.status !== "SENT"','!receipt?.message_id','!receipt?.message_url']
missing=[s for s in required if s not in idx]
missing += [s for s in ['Any validated `state=needs_human` classification must be sent through','$ops-discord','No exceptions'] if s not in skill]
print('missing', missing)
raise SystemExit(1 if missing else 0)
PY

cases.name: ops-discord-bot-transport-dry-run-resolves
command: cd ../../.. && ./skills/ops-discord/run.sh notify --discord-bot --channel-name horus --content 'needs-human discord guard dry-run probe' --dry-run --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['schema'], d['status'], d['ok'], d['transport'], d['channel_name'], d['external_effects'])"

stdout_contains: ops_discord.notification_receipt.v1 DRY_RUN True discord_bot horus False
